title: AppChip — remove _PressableChip wrapper to fix double-gesture conflict
objective: Delete the _PressableChip wrapper class and its surrounding if-block in lib/ui/core/widgets/display/app_chip.dart so AppChip returns the RawChip widget directly. RawChip already owns onPressed handling and its own splash feedback; the outer GestureDetector was double-firing taps and competing for the gesture arena.
description: The current build() method conditionally wraps the RawChip in a custom _PressableChip whenever onPressed != null (lines 105-112). _PressableChip contains its own GestureDetector with onTapDown / onTapUp / onTapCancel / onTap. Meanwhile the inner RawChip is also constructed with onPressed: onPressed at line 84, which Material wires through its own InkWell + GestureDetector. Two nested GestureDetectors claiming the same tap causes the documented 'double gesture' bug — taps can be dropped, press-state can stick, and splash ripples are misaligned. The fix is to delete the wrapper entirely. RawChip's onPressed already drives the press-state splash feedback that the design system needs; the outer AnimatedOpacity is redundant once the Material splash is in play.

anchors: lines 1-13 — file header comment block (DO NOT EDIT)
lines 17-142 — AppChip class (edit only lines 105-112 — the if (onPressed != null) block that returns _PressableChip)
lines 105-112 — DELETE the if-block that wraps chip in _PressableChip; the method simply returns chip unconditionally
lines 144-177 — _PressableChip class AND _PressableChipState (DELETE both classes entirely; they are no longer referenced after line 112 is removed)

ripple_replacement.behavior: RawChip.onPressed drives a Material InkWell splash + highlight automatically. No opacity-driven 'pressed' state is needed: the visual press feedback is the ripple itself, which is theme-consistent and respects MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) via Material's animation pipeline.
deletions: The 'if (onPressed != null) { ... return _PressableChip(...) }' branch at lines 105-112
AppDurations import (line 13) — verify it is no longer referenced anywhere else in the file and remove if unused

validation.manual_visual_check: Render an AppChip with onPressed set and confirm: (a) tapping fires onPressed exactly once (no double-fire); (b) the Material splash ripple appears and dismisses on release; (c) no opacity flicker on press; (d) toggling system 'Remove animations' does not break tap handling.

no_op_outside_scope: Do not modify AppChip's public constructor, the four factory constructors, ChipVariant, or the _colors helper. Do not migrate the chip to ActionChip / InputChip (that is out of scope for this fix). Do not introduce new tokens or animation durations.
